text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas. While the Tracen Academy
Umamusume were having a merry time—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, pleeease save me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Explanations later! Let's hurry go, yes!

Led along by a flustered-looking Taiki Shuttle,
I arrived at the Miho Dormitory cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san!
I brought some really reassuring backup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The helper was you, Trainer?!
Dorms are strictly off-limits to non-students!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right? But Hishi Ama-san
did say she'd 'take help from anyone she can get.'

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"They might not have cat paws to lend,
but Trainer-san will definitely lend us a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Can't be helped, then.
Alright, permission granted, so lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas! So I'm gonna
throw a surprise party for everyone at the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: When she told me she wanted to use the cafeteriaand gave her reasons, I just couldn't stay quiet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's just that the two of us got a little too carried away,
and now we've ended up in way over our heads.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer-san,
support, please!

It seems they came up with the idea of a party
to bring joy to the Umamusume.

It's a request typical of Taiki Shuttle,
wishing to make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Thank you very much, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's get ready to par-tay!
Leave the grilled meat to meee!

And so, thanks to all the preparation
for the party we were abruptly roped into—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki-senpai, thank you so much
for throwing such a wonderful party~."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Graaass! Are you enjoying yourself?
Please have lots and lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Every single bite is delicious!
Taiki-senpai, you're amazing! Incredible! Amiga!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind the seasoning, I have full confidence in my grilling!
People always praised me at barbecues!"

The Umamusume enjoyed the party,
their smiles never fading for even a moment.

I felt like I caught a glimpse of Taiki Shuttle's
earnest desire to make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was a truly wonderful party, wasn't it!
Everyone is happy, and I'm happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! It's all thanks to
your help, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, did you enjoy yourself, Trainer?
I feel like you were just carrying food the whole time..."
(Grrrumble~~...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Trainer's stomach
is screaming "Help me!"

"Come to think of it, I was so busy helping out
with the party that I haven't eaten a thing..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's head back to the cafeteria!
I will treat you to my cooking!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Seasoning aside, my grilling skills are
second to none, so please dig in!"
Afterward, Taiki Shuttle and I gathered around some rather salty food and continued the party.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Trainer-san.
I actually have a present for you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I made this dish while getting ready,
with Hishi Ama-san teaching me how to season it, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now Trainer-san will be happy too!
Please, enjoy the meal!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
Seeing you so happy makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...And, I'm super happy that you're
my Trainer... Hehehe."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good night!
Thank you sooo much for today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Please get plenty of rest!
Because tomorrow is the Christmas after-party!

I feel like she said something completely outrageous
at the very end, but we still had the best Christmas
where everyone ended up happy.
